_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002).

tasks.title: model_bakeoff.py capture: fixed interview cameras from config
tasks.notes: Retro R-013: each round copies the previous round's capture script (r013_capture.py = sed of r012_capture.py) under worlds/bakeoff/site/builds/. Do: move the camera table (square_south, street_front, aerial_top eye/look, aerial bbox [6140,-5584,6230,-5490], FOV, crop/rotation) into model-bakeoffs/config.json (or packs/v1) and add `model_bakeoff.py capture R-NNN` that captures via evidence_sheet._capture_view, writes shots to worlds/bakeoff/verification/site/<round>-shots/, writes the matching real_aerial.png crop from reference/aerial/susu, saves the world, and fills the round's `photos` map. Point sitting_steps 'capture fixed cameras' at it. Done when: per-round capture scripts are no longer needed; a unit test covers the photos-map/crop maths with a stubbed capture function. Prefix world commands with AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff.

tasks.title: Keep earlier rounds' build scripts out of the next sitting's view
tasks.notes: Retro R-013 fairness: worlds/bakeoff/site/builds/ holds r010..r013 SUSU build scripts, lidar/osm caches and capture scripts next to where the model writes its own; R-012 disclosed reading the R-011 docstring (prior evidence summary). Pack rule: a previous Minecraft build is not evidence. Do: as part of `model_bakeoff.py baseline` (task 72) move prior round artefacts matching `r0NN_*` out of site/builds/ into an archive dir the brief tells the model not to use (e.g. worlds/bakeoff/archive/rounds/<id>/), and have `open` warn if any are still present. Add one line to packs/v1/FAIRNESS.md (not BRIEF.md, which is frozen) naming the archive as off-limits. Done when: after baseline, site/builds/ contains no earlier-round files; open warns on leftovers; test covers the move. Prefix world commands with AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff.

tasks.title: Bake-off usage: same unit every round (transcript sum + plan %)
tasks.notes: Retro R-013: usage is recorded in incomparable units (Claude subagent totals ~200k with no cache split; Codex rollout counters; Claude Code transcript sums incl. cache reads ~5-7M; weekly plan % only sometimes), so Sonnet vs Opus cost could not be compared. Do in scripts/model_bakeoff.py: (1) `usage R-NNN --from-transcript <path.jsonl> [--model-prefix claude-opus-5-5]` that sums per-response API usage de-duplicated by message id (input, output, cache_read, cache_write, requests, first/last timestamp) and records source=api; this is the script hand-written in R-012/R-013. Support subagent transcripts too. (2) Add optional plan-usage fields `plan_pct_start` / `plan_pct_end` (weekly, all models) to the usage block, settable on `open` and `score` (`--plan-pct N`), plus `wallclock_min` and `interruptions` notes. (3) Document in model-bakeoffs/PROTOCOL.md Usage section that cross-model cost comparison uses plan % delta + transcript sums, and that agent-report subagent totals are not comparable. Done when: unit test sums a fixture transcript with duplicate message ids correctly; status output shows plan % delta where present.

tasks.title: feature_build: per-zone roof heights within one footprint
tasks.notes: Retro R-012/R-013: rules/feature-builds.md requires scripts/feature_build.py, but its spec takes one `storeys` count per OSM way (STOREY_H=3), so SUSU (one way, w33830305, with lidar roof plateaus at 41/45/46/47/48/50 m AOD terraced into a ~10 m slope) cannot be expressed; both Opus rounds wrote ~340-line custom site_kit scripts, the most expensive and error-prone part of a sitting and the gap weaker models fail on. Do: add an optional spec key (e.g. `zones: {"<label>": {"from": "lidar", "levels": [..] | "auto", "bucket": 4, "axis_deg": "auto"}}`) that splits a footprint into flat roof zones: 5x5 median DSM, snap to plateau levels, mode-filter, then bucket on the building's rotated grid so zone edges are straight runs; walls run from local lidar ground up so downhill faces gain storeys; parapet on every roof edge including zone steps. Reuse existing facades/doors/roofs per zone label. Keep the 1-block-stair squaring and print the `footprint osm=N readable=M pad=P cover=C%` line. Reference implementation to read (not copy verbatim): worlds/bakeoff/site/builds/r013_susu.py (evidence() and build()). Update rules/feature-builds.md. Done when: a SUSU spec using zones dry-runs end-to-end with 0 guard failures, and unit tests cover zone snapping, bucketing and edge-wall exposure with a fixture height grid.

tasks.title: Bake-off round record keeps its build script
tasks.notes: Retro R-013: the round's evidence table + build script live in the gitignored world checkout (worlds/bakeoff/site/builds/r013_susu.py), so the tool-repo commit scoring the round (b151838) does not contain them and the record is not self-contained. Do: on `model_bakeoff.py score` copy the round's build script(s) and capture metadata into model-bakeoffs/rounds/R-NNN/ (like the existing R-008-photos / R-009-photos dirs) and record the paths in the round JSON (`artefacts`). Take the script path from a new `open`/`score` flag or from the plan name in the journal entry the round's apply recorded. Skip large binaries (npz) and screenshots unless already the convention. Done when: scoring a round leaves its build script under model-bakeoffs/rounds/R-NNN/ and the JSON points at it; test covers the copy. Prefix world commands with AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff.
